description: WritingSample migration (src/lib/voice/migration.ts + scripts/migrate-writing-samples.ts) and the Document Management UI (/documents page with upload form, category-grouped list, and document detail view).
steps: 1. Create src/lib/voice/migration.ts with migrateWritingSamples(): for each WritingSample, create a SourceDocument (category: work-artifact, authorship: user-authored, documentDate: sample.createdAt, title: sample.title, content: sample.content). Then run ingestDocument on the new SourceDocument. Track which samples have been migrated by checking for existing SourceDocuments with matching title+content to ensure idempotency.
2. Create scripts/migrate-writing-samples.ts that imports and runs migrateWritingSamples(). Use tsx runner per existing package.json pattern.

3. Modify src/lib/profile-context.ts getVoiceGuidance function to add console.warn('DEPRECATED: getVoiceGuidance is deprecated. Use topic-based passage retrieval from src/lib/voice/retrieval.ts instead.') at the top of the function. Do NOT remove the function.

4. Create src/app/documents/page.tsx as a 'use client' page with: (a) Upload form with required fields (title input, category dropdown with all 6 categories, authorship radio with 'I wrote this'/'Someone else wrote this'/'Collaborative'/'Unknown', authorName field shown conditionally when third-party, date picker for documentDate, content textarea, confidential checkbox, currentEmployer checkbox). (b) List view grouped by category with document count per category. (c) Document detail view (click to expand) showing metadata, passage count, passages with topics. (d) Accessible: ARIA labels on all form controls, keyboard navigable.
5. Create src/lib/__tests__/voice-migration.test.ts testing migration idempotency (mock prisma to verify it checks for existing documents before creating).
6. Ensure npm run lint && npm run build pass.
acceptance_criteria: migrateWritingSamples converts each WritingSample to SourceDocument + VoicePassages
Migration is idempotent - running twice does not create duplicates
Old WritingSample data is NOT deleted
getVoiceGuidance logs a deprecation warning when called
Document upload form enforces required fields client-side
Authorship selection shows human-readable labels with conditional authorName field
List view shows documents grouped by category with counts
Document detail shows passage count and passages with topic tags
All form controls have ARIA labels
npx vitest run passes all tests
